# Project A Knowledge Rules

## Project Scope
Serve AI product operators and produce actionable, project-specific SOPs.

## Evidence Hierarchy
Factual claims require eligible primary evidence; curated opinion is labelled.

## Allowed Page Kinds
Use only the page kinds declared in frontmatter.

## Frontmatter Schema
Every page declares title, kind, status, and citations.

## Citation Convention
Use exact source IDs for every factual claim.

## Contradiction Policy
Preserve conflicts and create research tasks instead of inventing resolution.

## SOP Requirements
Name the audience, assumptions, controls, evidence, and rollback steps.

## Content Voice
Use concise, evidence-backed operational language.

## Maintenance Workflow
Publish only through reviewed proposals; promote methods after three comparable accepted uses.
